1879111786.name: Mighty Blast: Horn of Gondor
1879111786.desc: Makes a full AoE attack, which stuns your opponents.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Stun replaced with a mount speed debuff</rgb>

1879139050.name: Dire Howl
1879139050.desc:
You let loose an eerie howl, silencing enemies around you. <rgb=#FF7700> 
 
 In Flayer: Howl of Aggression. 
 Disarms up to 4 targets. 
 
 In Shadow: Howl from the Shadow 
 Silences up to 4 targets and enter stealth.  </rgb>

1879143274.name: Warden's Triumph
1879143274.desc: A triumphant blow, allowing the Warden to deal even more damage.

1879146218.name: Improved Valiant Strike
1879146218.desc: A melee attack that heals the Morale of nearby allies, and also grants a Heal-over-time.

Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879198314.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Polar Bear)
1879198314.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879228138.name: Shield and Spear
1879228138.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their shield and spear for attack.

1879232490.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Raven)
1879232490.desc: Your bond with the natural world allows you to call upon old friends long gone.

1879240810.name: a mounted ranged attack
1879240810.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a javelin.

1879259882.name: Explosive Arrow
1879259882.desc: Fires an explosive arrow at the targetted area.\n\nAll enemies that come in contact with the brief but intense blaze will take fire damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879262698.name: All In
1879262698.desc: Briefly boost your damage, Evade chance, and Finesse rating to try to finish a fight -- but beware if the enemy survives.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Landing a Killing Blow before All In expires prevents the negative effect</rgb>

1879263722.name: Eyes of the Hunter
1879263722.desc: The embodiment of a natural-born predator, you are able to share your secrets of the hunt with those around you.

1879272170.name: Pony of the Midsummer
1879272170.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879274090.name: Snap Shot - Hampering Javelin of Fire
1879274090.desc: Javelins can pierce body parts or equipment and slow the target until the javelin can be removed.

1879275754.name: Invigoration
1879275754.desc: You feel as though you could take on the entire army yourself.

1879315178.name: Nature's Mend
1879315178.desc: You call on nature to increase the Morale of your target's fellowship.

1879325290.name: Return to Arnach
1879325290.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Arnach, you're able to quickly return to Arnach in eastern Gondor. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879389418.name: Defensive Strike
1879389418.desc: You attack defensively, entering a Battle-readied state.

Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879412458.name: Boon of the Deathless
1879412458.desc: When you would otherwise suffer fatal damage, instead heal 5% morale and become immune to defeat for 3s.

1879412714.name: Lively Slug
1879412714.desc: Summons a lively slug to brighten your day.

1879412842.name: Harbinger of the Sage's Storm
1879412842.desc: Summons a companion of the Autumn Sage.

1879418602.name: Dappled Tri-colour Cat
1879418602.desc: Summons a cuddly tri-colour cat to keep you company.

1879426410.name: Mettle Shield
1879426410.desc: Use your Mettle to defend against incoming attacks.\n\nGain significant incoming damage reduction. In this state, successful attacks against the Brawler will remove 2 Mettle.

1879449578.name: Lesser Anthem I - Resonance
1879449578.desc:
Anthem: Increases your Outgoing Healing and reduces the Induction time of your Healing Skills. Increases Outgoing Healing and reduces Inductions for all nearby fellowship or raid members.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 1 ballad buff present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

<rgb=#00ff00>Makes your next Bolster Courage instant cast. This buff lasts for ten seconds.</rgb>

1879458538.name: Stand Alone
1879458538.desc: Sometimes, a captain is forced to stand alone. When necessary, you are capable of displaying great combat prowess even without an audience.\n\nThis skill will prevent the use of Blade-brother while active.

1879464170.name: Guide to Pelargir
1879464170.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Pelargir in King's Gondor.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879491562.name: Light of Hope
1879491562.desc: Transfers Morale to an ally or companion.

1879495146.name: Golden Flowers
1879495146.desc: Place down a pot of fantastic golden flowers to show off.

1879497706.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497706.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879506538.name: Prepare: Shadow-spike
1879506538.desc: Sends a shadowy spike at a target dealing damage, reducing their tactical prowess.

1879507818.name: Unseen Scheme
1879507818.desc: In a puff of smoke and a whirl of blades, you rend the armour of enemies around you.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879516650.name: Drop Blue Mushroom
1879516650.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879521386.name: Burdened Mûmak Calf
1879521386.desc: Summons a helpful, but burdened mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.

1879523178.name: Broad Remorseless Strike
1879523178.desc:
Uses fervour to deal a devastating attack.

This attack is hard to defend.

Critical hits deal massive damage. 
 
 Critical hits will reset Emboldened Blades.

1879528810.name: Prepared: Acid-spike
1879528810.desc: Send a spike of acid at your target, weakening them.
